campaign_event_policy.rule: fixed for every supported SHEIN mode; reject a clone or duplication source whose ad set does not use ADD_TO_WISHLIST

tracking.numbering: fresh live maximum plus consecutive target numbers
tracking.rule: never reuse source utm_campaign or utm_adgroup

from_zero_prestaged.label: criar do zero
from_zero_prestaged.creative_payload: new object_story_spec with one of image_url/image_hash and no legacy standard_enhancements

pure_clone.label: duplicar igual com tracking novo e prova social
pure_clone.creative_payload: two-phase existing-post route: PAUSED lineage copy with only the Advantage+ override, standalone creative with source object_story_id plus target url_tags, attach, readback and activation
pure_clone.social_proof_gate: target object_story_id/effective_object_story_id equal source post and direct reactions/comments/shares readback
pure_clone.tracking_gate: target url_tags contain the new target campaign/adgroup tokens
pure_clone.learning_caveat: new campaign and ad set do not inherit source learning or historical metrics

clone_prestaged.label: clonar estrutura com criativos novos
clone_prestaged.creative_payload: new object_story_spec plus Graph v26 media_sourcing_spec for every primary video

graph_v26_normalization.image_thumbnail: send exactly one of image_url or image_hash
graph_v26_normalization.legacy_standard_enhancements: forbidden; replace top-level degrees_of_freedom_spec with approved individual features
graph_v26_normalization.new_video_on_ad_copy: primary object_story_spec video must also exist in media_sourcing_spec.videos
graph_v26_normalization.pure_clone_social: source_ad_id alone is insufficient evidence; preserve the source post explicitly

hot_path_optimization.media_timing: on demand only after the exact ad account is present in the request
hot_path_optimization.forbidden_default: do not prestage globally or upload to multiple ad accounts by inference
hot_path_optimization.pure_clone: use existing_post_two_phase directly; never probe the known-failing inline object_story_id plus url_tags copy route
hot_path_optimization.ad_count: one through five for clone and pure clone, driven by the authorized request without code edits
hot_path_optimization.pipeline: independent downloads and vertical uploads may run concurrently after account and asset reservation are reconciled

page_assignment_policy: Business Manager assignment is supported for SHEIN Pages; live Page/task validation remains mandatory

quota.empty_outer_headers: must not erase a previously live-confirmed tier

drive.selection_gate: current Drive parent plus inventory lineage plus Meta ad/video use reconciliation
drive.postprocess: move only assets used by new-media campaigns to 02_TESTING after full Meta readback

performance.target_status: achieved in mixed on-demand benchmark with four fresh vertical uploads and one exact-account registry reuse
performance.timing_requirement: runner state records per-stage duration_ms and total duration_ms

write_policy.recovery: readback first; preserve request and IDs; write only missing or invalid layers; never blind replay
write_policy.permanent_delete: never without a separate explicit authorization
